notes: Albums is separated from playlists for good. The ⋮ menu on the Albums tab no longer offers the playlist behind it (Clear playlist, Delete playlist, a DJ Mode toggle), Export albums exports your albums instead of zipping the open playlist, and the Reorder Songs sheet’s “Switch album” list only shows the albums YOU made — no more albums you never created

Tap the record player in the now bar and SideCut opens the album the playing song is in, scrolls to that song and highlights it. If the song isn’t in one of your albums yet, its album tag becomes yours when you tap, so the jump never lands on an empty tab

Home is the layout you asked for. The bubble order is now stats, now playing beside top artists, quick actions, pinned artists beside new releases, library beside most played, playlists, then notifications beside favorites — and you can size every bubble exactly: Sandbox (free) has width/height steppers per bubble, plus two new presets (mini and XL) in the ⋮ chip cycle
The New releases bubble has a ✓ chip that marks every release as read in one tap, without opening the list first

RGB and RGB + are smooth now. The cycle ran on a 200ms timer — five colour steps a second — which is the choppy colour you could see while a song played. It now updates on the display’s own frames (and skips steps too small to see), with the old timer kept only as a watchdog for a WebView that stops delivering frames. The bounce-reactive bars in RGB+ are drawn at half the rate, which was the heaviest thing running during playback

Five new premium dynamic themes: Nebula, Neon Pulse, Solstice, Abyss and Orchid. Every dynamic theme also gets a second layer that counter-moves in the theme’s own accent colours plus a slow sheen, so they actually move instead of one gradient drifting. All of the motion is transform/opacity only, which the compositor runs without repainting
